messages:
From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@resellco.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Merchant onboarding - initial evidence bundle for CPPO

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Per our call, attaching the initial evidence bundle for the private offer: entitlement-matrix.csv and our company-signed LOA (company-signed-LOA.pdf). We also included a short note on our billing entity mapping (see first tab in the CSV).

A few quick asks from your side so we can keep the internal calendar:
- Is Redwood able to accept the reseller billing entity as the payor on the CPPO, or must the merchant be the payor?
- Do you need any additional technical evidence (SAML metadata or KMS key fingerprints) to complete the eligibility review?
- Can you share the DocuSign link when the offer is ready for signatures?

We'd like to aim for a soft go-live window in the week of Mar 20 if the evidence review completes this week.

Thanks,
Jamie Ortiz
Head of Partner Ops — ResellCo
partner-ops@cloudscale-resell.com
Attachments: entitlement-matrix.csv (text/csv), company-signed-LOA.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@resellco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merchant onboarding - initial evidence bundle for CPPO

Jamie — thanks for the files and the clear ask. Quick notes after initial pass: 

- Payor: For AWS CPPO we can route the private offer to a reseller as payor in most cases, but there are a couple of billing/legal nuances for multi-entity merchants. Ben and Karthik, can you confirm whether the account tax ID on the CSV maps to an allowed payor entity?

- Tech evidence: SAML metadata isn't strictly required for marketplace listing approval, but AWS sometimes wants KMS/FI fingerprint evidence for encrypted artifacts. If you can share SAML metadata and the KMS key alias, that'll keep the evidence bundle comprehensive.

- DocuSign: we'll prepare the DocuSign envelope once the entitlement matrix is validated. I will attach the latest playbook and the evidence checklist for you to review — please fill any missing rows directly in the spreadsheet and re-upload.

Attachments: redwood-cppo-merchant-playbook-v1.3.docx; evidence-checklist.xlsx

Next steps (proposed):
1) ResellCo completes evidence-checklist.xlsx by EOD Fri, Mar 2
2) Redwood validates entitlement-matrix.csv and confirms payor mapping by Mon, Mar 5
3) DocuSign envelope prepared and shared Tue, Mar 6
4) Private offer activation targeted Mar 21 (contingent on AWS scheduling)

If that timeline looks tight, flag which merchants we should prioritize and we can move them into the first activation slot.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform

Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merchant onboarding - initial evidence bundle for CPPO

+1 on Monica's plan. A couple items from commercial side: 

- Pricing exception: We approved the reseller uplift for this merchant but need final signed LOA before we finalize the invoice flow. Jamie, once you upload the LOA to the Drive folder I linked below, I will open the HubSpot deal and record the payor info.
- HubSpot: here's the deal record for tracking (please paste merchant account IDs into the 'External IDs' field): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765

Also, quick ask: if ResellCo wants the reseller to be the invoice payor, AWS sometimes needs the reseller's Marketplace Seller ID listed on the offer. Jamie — please include your AWS Marketplace Seller ID in the evidence-checklist (new row).

Thanks — I'll hold off on gating DocuSign until we have the final LOA.

Ben Carter

ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0207

Answers:
- Reseller Seller ID: 424242424242
- KMS alias: alias/resellco-marketplace-key-1 (fingerprint included in Drive docs)
- We're comfortable being payor for these 3 merchants; we've noted the merchant-level tax IDs in the CSV.

DocuSign note: envelope EF-87421 is staged and will be routed to Redwood once you create the CPPO offer draft. We can sign as soon as the DocuSign route is attached.

Let me know if you need me to jump on a 15-min call to triage any missing evidence — happy to do that tomorrow morning.

Jamie
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround, Jamie. Quick status update and action items: 

- Redwood validated the entitlement matrix and the seller ID; Karthik confirmed the payor mapping is acceptable for the three merchants.
- DocuSign: I'll create the CPPO DocuSign envelope on Mon morning and will attach DocuSign envelope EF-87421 as the sign-off path. Expect the envelope in your inbox by Tue, Mar 6.
- Engineering/Marketplace ops: I've added a ticket to Marketplace Ops to request the private offer slot with AWS for Mar 21 (ticket: MP-4789). They'll confirm slot availability by next Wed.
- Follow-up call: Jamie — let's do a 15-min sync Mon at 9:30am PT to confirm signatures and any last-minute evidence. I've invited you and Ben to the calendar event.

Deliverables:
1) DocuSign envelope shared (Mon, Mar 6)
2) Marketplace Ops slot confirmed (by Wed, Mar 8)
3) Private offer activation (target Mar 21)

If anything blocks, escalate to me and I'll loop in Marketplace engineering. Appreciate the quick responses — on track.

—Monica
